_meta.title: repro_20260220_v7p1_trainlog
_meta.summary: V7P1 reproducibility config: persist training process logs to train_flow.log by default.
commands: conda run -n ros2py310 python train.py --profile v7p1 --episodes 300 --out repro_20260220_v7p1_trainlog --device cuda --progress
conda run -n ros2py310 python infer.py --profile v7p1 --models repro_20260220_v7p1_trainlog --runs 5 --out repro_20260220_v7p1_trainlog
notes: train.py now writes <run_dir>/train_flow.log by default via --save-train-log=true.
This repro keeps the same algorithmic settings as v7p1; only output naming differs.
